definition: to wipe out a whole population at once
description: A shallow coral reef in clear blue water. A young diver in a black and blue wetsuit, mask and air tank swims low over the reef and reaches towards the coral, with bubbles rising above her. Most of the coral around her has died and turned bone white: large branching white corals and pale round corals, with only a few patches of brown coral left. A yellow measuring tape and a white slate lie across the reef, and one small orange fish swims among the white branches. The diver turns her head and looks straight ahead with wide eyes.

to swim among the coral branches
